overview.text: Shri Vishwakarma Skill University (SVSU), Gurugram, Haryana, invites e-tenders for design, development, configuration and implementation of a cloud based Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system. Implementation is estimated at 1 Year from issuance of work order, followed by AMC support (operation and maintenance) for 5 Years. Tender Reference Number: SVSU/2020/ITCELL/RFP001.

summary.issuing_organization: Shri Vishwakarma Skill University (SVSU), Gurugram, Haryana; Tender Reference Number SVSU/2020/ITCELL/RFP001; contact office: Registrar, Plot 147, Sector 44, Gurugram, registrar@svsu.ac.in; Dr. Ravinder Kumar

scope.text: Design, develop, deploy (cloud hosting for five years) and maintain the ERP system, and customize and enhance module functionality as per SVSU requirements during the contract period.
Provision the cloud infrastructure for hosting, plus a dashboard with DNS and DNS hosting; operate and maintain the application and cloud infrastructure.

Integrated ERP of 14 modules, including Administration, Student Management, Examination and Skill Assessment, Accounting & Finance, Library, Estate, IQAC, International Collaboration, Skill School, Training and Placement, Affiliation Portal, Students Activity, Web/Mobile and Virtual Classroom.
Develop the university website, the feeder school website and the ERP web interface, plus a mobile application giving access to selected ERP modules and employee records.
Develop a virtual classroom, meeting and webinar platform with audio/video conferencing, recording, whiteboard and capacity of up to 500 participants.
Integrate with any LMS or other SVSU module, and include SMS, e-mail and payment integration across all modules, with drill down dashboards and MIS reports.
Train SVSU users for two weeks (i.e. 40 hrs. of training / week) per batch and provide user manuals for students, faculty and administrative staff.

key_requirements.text: Software must be tested and certified by a CERT-in empaneled security auditor after implementation and before Go Live; the bidder must support the auditor and make the required updates.

Application must be deployed only after security audit and certification, including static analysis (source code scanning) and black-box scanning with patching; any added or changed module must be audited again.
Proposed product must be platform independent and able to integrate with a mobile app for MIS reporting.
ERP solution availability must be at least 99.99% during the operation and maintenance period.
Critical (P1) incidents: response time 10 Minutes and resolution time 60 Minutes.
Support must be 24x7; normal technical support hours are 09:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Saturday, with on-call support otherwise for critical incidents.
Bidder must provide onsite support of at least one functional and one technical resource for 5 years after Go-Live; technical staff must understand English and Hindi.
Bidder must back up ERP services and data daily to a local storage server at the university campus (supplied by the bidder) and weekly to an external hard drive.
Bidder must manage the application and its hosting in a disaster recovery (DR) site in the cloud and guarantee uptime as per SLA.
Bidder must provide the API and integrate the ERP with other ERPs running in the university (if any) without any additional cost.

eligibility.text: Average annual turnover from ERP and similar work must be at least INR 100 Crores per year in the last three (3) financial years ending 31.03.2019, with positive net-worth as on 31.03.2019.
Must have implemented at least 2 (Two) Educational ERP systems for universities in India, including support, maintenance and services.
Must hold a valid ISO/IEC 27001 certificate and at least CMMi level 3 certification for software design, development and testing.
Consortium bids are not allowed; a declaration must be submitted.
Bidder must not be blacklisted by any Central or State department or establishment in India at any point of time; a notarized affidavit is compulsory.
Core implementation team (Project Manager, Solution Architect, Functional Lead, Technical Lead, Programmers, Data Entry Operators etc.) must be on the bidder's payroll; undertaking required.
Bidder must own the copyright of the solution's source code and be able to change any component throughout the term of Agreement; copyright certificate required.
Bidder must have existed in India for the last ten (10) years and been in IT/ITeS business for the last five (5) years at the end of 31st March 2019, and be solvent at the date of bidding.

important_dates.text: Last date for receipt of queries by mail: up to 12th July, 2020; 17:00 Hrs.
Online bid submission starts: 16th July, 2020; 14:00 Hrs.
Bid and EMD submission closing: 04th August, 2020; 14:00 Hrs.
Financial bid opening: To be notified later.
Proposals must remain valid for 180 days from bid submission date, and rates quoted must not change.

commercial_requirements.text: Tender fee Rs. 25,000/- + GST and e-service fee Rs. 1000/- + GST, non-refundable, paid online on the e-tender portal.
EMD of 110 Lakhs, payable online on the e-tender portal only; Pay Order/Cheque/DD/BG not accepted; forfeited if an accepted offer is not honoured.
Performance Bank Guarantee is mandatory: 10% of the purchase/work order value, to reach the Registrar within 21 days from the date of Signing of contract and stay valid during the contract.

Development and deployment payment: 40 % on completion of Phase I (inclusive of cloud cost for first year), 30 % on Phase 2, and 30 % after ERP has run successfully for six months after full deployment.
Cloud charges are paid annually in advance; the AMC is paid quarterly in equal instalments.
Prices must be quoted in Indian National Rupee (INR), inclusive of all expenses and all kinds of taxes; no price escalation is allowed.
Liquidated damages for missing the completion date: 0.5% of the contract value for each week or part thereof, capped at 10% of the total contract value.
SLA penalties deduct 0.25 % to 0.75 % of the quarterly AMC payment per parameter when deviations exceed 2 occurrence in a quarter; total penalty must not exceed 10% of the total project cost.

project_duration.text: Implementation (estimated): 1 Year from date of issuance of work order; AMC support (operation and maintenance): 5 Years after implementation.

Indicative milestones from signing of contract: gap analysis and requirement gathering T + 2, Phase I T + 5, Phase II T + 9, Phase III T + 12 months; bidders may propose own timelines but Go live must stay within T+12 Months.
Operations and maintenance for 5 years after implementation; the contract may be extended up to another 3 + 3 year on mutually agreed terms.
After contract termination SVSU may require the bidder to keep running operations for a period of 6 months.
The agreement must be signed on Rs. l00/- Non Judicial Stamp paper within 15 days after receiving the Purchase Order/Work Order.

important_conditions.text: Evaluation: Only bidders meeting the eligibility criteria are technically evaluated; at least 70% marks in technical evaluation are needed for financial proposal opening; selection by QCBS with 70% weight to technical and 30% to financial.
Evaluation: Technical parameters carry 10 marks each for average turnover, ERP implemented in Indian universities, employee strength and student users.

Evaluation: 5 marks each for ISO/IEC certificates, CMMi level, open source use, mobile application capability, Hindi-English bilingual modules and visually impaired compatibility; 30 marks for technical presentation, project plan and understanding of objectives.

Submission: Submit online at the Haryana e-procurement portal in two folders (Technical and Financial Proposal) with a Class-II or Class-III Digital Signature Certificate; documents must be virus scanned and digitally signed.
Submission: A technical bid without tender fee, e-service charge and EMD is UNRESPONSIVE and will not be accepted.
Submission: Copies of documents must be attested by a gazetted officer or notary public; unattested documents will not be entertained.
Submission: Notarized originals of the affidavits (on Non Judicial Stamp of Rs. 100/-) must be delivered to the SVSU Transit office on the Technical Presentation day/date.
Submission: Financial proposal must be submitted online in BOQ format only; a manually submitted financial bid will not be accepted.
Risk: Minimum technical qualifying marks conflict: 70% in the evaluation clause versus 60 in the worked example.
Risk: Turnover and net-worth reference date conflicts: financial years ending 31.03.2019 in the eligibility table versus 31st March, 2020 in the auditor certificate format.
Risk: Timeline basis conflicts: 1 Year from issuance of work order versus T+12 Months from signing of contract for Go live.
Risk: Liquidated damages (0.5% per week, up to 10%) and SLA penalties can be imposed simultaneously, and SVSU may terminate if liquidated damages exceed 10% of the order value.
Risk: Scope is open-ended: the module list is broad and tentative, more modules may be added, and project scope is indicative and may vary as per SVSU requirement.
Risk: All IPR, including source code, database, licenses and cloud services, will be in the name of SVSU, which has sole proprietary rights.
